name: RollCall mobile, direction A: Tide Table
note: Colours are OKLCH with an sRGB hex fallback (every OKLCH value is inside sRGB, so both render the same). Contrast ratios were computed from the hex values; the prototype's measure script re-checks them on the rendered page.

paper-200.use: dividers (decorative only, never the only edge of a control)

ink-950.use: top bar and Today's status band

ink-900.use: raised tiles on the status band

ink-800.use: tracks and rules on the status band

ink-text.use: primary text on light (15.6:1 on paper-50)

ink-500.use: muted text, meta (5.7:1 on paper-50, 5.4:1 on paper-100)

ink-400.use: control borders and icons (3.9:1 on white, 3.8:1 on paper-50); never text

on-ink.use: primary text on ink (16.5:1 on ink-950)

on-ink-3.use: muted text on ink (7.8:1 on ink-950, 6.9:1 on ink-900)

tide-600.use: the one solid primary button, links (white text 6.6:1)

tide-700.use: pressed primary, tonal button text (7.3:1 on tide-100)

coral-500.use: Do today edge and markers (graphics only, 3.7:1 on white)

coral-600.use: Do today text and costs (5.3:1 on white)

coral-100.use: Do today chip, error banner, danger tonal button

coral-300.use: Do today on ink (8.6:1 on ink-950)

amber-100.use: before-close chip, partial banner, stale chip

amber-300.use: Friday expiries on ink (11.6:1 on ink-950)

sea-600.use: credits, covered, green grade (5.7:1 on white)

display.source: Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License 1.1

body.source: Google Fonts (Braille Institute), SIL Open Font License 1.1

font.numbers: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums wherever money, prices or counts line up (both families have tnum)

display.use: one per view: the status figure, a screen title, a ticket's result

title.use: stock symbols, card and sheet titles, section heads

label.use: meta, chips, tab labels, axis labels; uppercase eyebrows at 700 with 0.06em tracking

type.rules: Four sizes only (36/20/16/14). Nothing under 14 px; anything a person reads as a sentence, every button and every input is 16 px. Long lines stay under 60 characters on a phone.

uses: cards enter: 8 px rise + fade, 50 ms stagger
card leaves: height to 0 + fade at base
gauge and figures draw in once per visit
motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: every transition and animation off; state changes stay instant and visible

focus.ring: 3px solid tide-600, 2px offset; on ink: 3px solid on-ink
